Crisis timeline

A chronological record of scenario events, newest first. Filter by severity.

Fictional scenarios — not real events.

Every entry below is an illustrative fictional scenario created to demonstrate the timeline interface. None of these incidents happened. They must never be quoted as facts, referenced as news, or used for any operational purpose.

Scenarios like these are what analysts use in disruption modelling — ranges of outcomes rather than predictions. See the regional analysis page for exposure assessments, and methodology for how this data is labelled.

HORMUZ WATCH

An open shipping-intelligence dashboard for the Strait of Hormuz — vessel activity, energy markets, insurance signals and regional analysis in one place.

Data notice: unless a panel is marked LIVE, all figures are simulated demonstration data. Never use this site for trading, navigation or safety-critical decisions.
